verdict.rationale: Superhuman's docs strongly and repeatedly claim Auto Drafts write in the user's own voice and tone (matching sent-email style, per-recipient style), are ready to edit and send, and pull context from inbox/calendar/web rather than generic boilerplate. This is backed by multiple first-party sources describing the feature in detail, though independent/hands-on verification of voice-matching quality is absent. Missing for 10: independent user reports specifically validating voice/tone accuracy, and any critique of draft quality from community sources.
